notes:
What's new

- EPUB books have a chapter rail: every chapter is a card you can click, and the one you are reading stays highlighted.
- Page Down / Page Up still turn chapters, and the rail keeps up when you scroll.
- Reading size is yours: Ctrl + makes the text larger, Ctrl - smaller, Ctrl 0 back to normal, and the choice is remembered.
- Book text is set to a comfortable line length instead of stretching across the window.
changelog: WinPreview 1.3.20 - book reading polish (1D). Fixed chapter rail with click-to-jump from measured offsets, 700px measure for books, reading size (13/15/18px) via Ctrl +/-/0 persisted in BookFontSize, deferred scroll for restored chapters, and chapter tracking that follows manual scrolling. Office suite now 83 checks.
